definitions.baseline: Original rebreak/fresh occupancy; fixed original raw opposite exits in all ablations.
definitions.simple_breakout: Minimal12-bar anchor plus SAME rebreak wrapper; combined benchmark, not a single-rule removal.
definitions.state: Each cohort uses its own anchor feature and pre2025 signal-derived cutpoints. Unknown excluded explicitly.
definitions.paired: Common mature variant/baseline outcomes on available matched opportunities; no-fill/skipped/filtered zero, required unknown excluded.
definitions.R: Equal-risk arithmetic; realized closedR drawdown is not account or intratrade drawdown.
definitions.statistics: Weekly clustered exploratory historical estimates; rule/state Holm families separate, no forward claim.
definitions.AUC_top_decile: Not applicable to these fixed categorical entry rules: no classifier, fitted ranking or top-decile policy.

limitations: 638 archived Binance identities and ticks are not point-in-time.
No funding, additional slippage, queue or shared-capital model.
Stateful removals can replace anchors; this is an entry-only ablation, not a complete changed exit detector.
Known/mature pair coverage differs across comparisons; never compare a full signal sum with its paired random sum.
History reused; pre2025 selection/post2025 evaluation is chronological diagnosis, not unseen validation.
